assertion_floor: 7 in §1 + 1 in §2 + (2 sites x 2 questions) + 2 chain in §3 + 4 in §4 + 3 in §5 = 21. Every check() runs unconditionally - no early return, no conditional section, and the only multiplier is SITES.length, which expected_targets declares as 2 and §2 asserts as an equality. So the count is fixed by the question list and cannot fall without a diff somebody has to justify: a tripwire on the code, not a run-time check.

canary.what: the pre-fix job-record sentence, which names neither the space used nor the limit
